title: CaC: Advancing Video Reward Models via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Concentrating
abstract: arXiv:2605.11723v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we propose Concentrate and Concentrate (CaC), a coarse-to-fine anomaly reward model based on Vision-Language Models. During inference, it first conducts a global temporal scan to anchor anomalous time windows, then performs fine-grained spatial grounding within the localized interval, and finally derives robust judgments via structured spatiotemporal Chain-of-Thought reasoning. To equip the model with these capabilities, we construct the first large-scale generated video anomaly dataset with per-frame bounding-box annotations, temporal anomaly windows, and fine-grained attribution labels. Building on this dataset, we design a three-stage progressive training paradigm. The model initially learns spatial and temporal anchoring through single- and multi-frame supervised fine-tuning, and then is optimized by a reinforcement learning strategy based on two-turn Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). translated_title: CaC：通过分层时空聚焦推进视频奖励模型
translated_abstract: 本文提出了“聚焦再聚焦”（Concentrate and Concentrate, CaC），一种基于视觉-语言模型的由粗到细异常奖励模型。在推理过程中，它首先进行全局时间扫描以锚定异常时间窗口，然后在定位的区间内执行细粒度空间定位，最后通过结构化时空思维链推理得出稳健的判断。为了使模型具备这些能力，我们构建了首个带有逐帧边界框标注、时间异常窗口以及细粒度归因标签的大规模生成视频异常数据集。基于该数据集，我们设计了一个三阶段渐进式训练范式：模型首先通过单帧和多帧监督微调学习空间和时间锚定，然后通过基于两轮组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习策略进行优化。除了常规……
tldr: 提出了基于视觉-语言模型的由粗到细异常奖励模型CaC，通过全局时间扫描、细粒度空间定位与结构化时空思维链推理进行异常判断，并构建了首个带逐帧边界框标注的大规模生成视频异常数据集及三阶段渐进式训练范式。
en_tdlr: Proposes CaC, a coarse-to-fine anomaly reward model based on Vision-Language Models that performs global temporal scanning, fine-grained spatial grounding, and structured spatiotemporal Chain-of-Thought reasoning, together with the first large-scale generated video anomaly dataset with per-frame bounding-box annotations and a three-stage progressive training paradigm.
